reading.action: Weld the Warden's chain to the butt of Burning Anger; swing it in a circle and hurl it into the haven from the threshold to latch onto the table/chairs and drag them out without entering (willing to take many tries).
reading.result: CHAIN-GRAPPLE (1d20 seed 413882047 -> 9, mid; no crit/fumble). Weld = routine Smithing auto-success (maul core spent-low since t68 -> weld-heat drawn from his own ember: focus 95->89, -6). TAKE-20 shape (improvised throw, no thrown-tether skill, low DC vs stationary near-pile, 'many tries') -> bones ASSURED; roll 9 = full haul but UGLY/slow. PHYSICS INVARIANT (lens-independent): hook passes THROUGH the glamour-feast (no purchase on table/chairs), host-image never reacts (projection); catches only on real charnel BONE beneath. FORK A: near pile within threshold reach; hearth/host-seat/deep hall set deep, beyond reach without a step in. FORK B: CLEAN while planted — floor does NOT grab/reverse the tether (won't blow its lure over a chain at the door). NON-MECHANICAL escalation: the illusion DOUBLES DOWN — welcome warms, host more insistent, gold RE-DRAPES over the torn gap (feast 'resetting'); eerie wrongness, NOT a threat-state change. ARMED-BOUND (grab arms only if he crosses the plane) NOT triggered — stayed planted. Cost: stamina 38->24 (-14, many casts/hauls, pure FINESSE labor). hp 124 unchanged. NO XP (salvage, not a cleared challenge). LOOT: grim proof = a prior climber's real bones (narrative, hardens distrust, no inventory line) + ONE tangible: Snapped cold-iron blade (atk 2 / forge stock). WEAPON EVOLUTION: Warden's chain-length WELDED to Burning Anger's butt -> chain-hafted maul (reach + grapple); chain fused, removed as separate item. Near-pile exhaustible. Ends on the situation; no assume of his next move. NO Tower reset.
